questions.question: Which treatment types have an average cost greater than 500, ordered from highest average cost to lowest?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT treatment_type, AVG(cost) AS average_cost FROM treatments GROUP BY treatment_type HAVING AVG(cost) > 500 ORDER BY average_cost DESC

questions.question: How many distinct patients had cancelled appointments?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients_with_cancelled_appointments FROM appointments WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

questions.question: How many appointments are there this month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND appointment_date < '2024-02-01'

questions.question: What was the total billed amount last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM billing WHERE bill_date >= '2023-12-01' AND bill_date < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: How many treatments were performed in March 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM treatments WHERE treatment_date >= '2023-03-01' AND treatment_date < '2023-04-01'

questions.question: How many appointments took place in the second quarter of 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date >= '2023-04-01' AND appointment_date < '2023-07-01'

questions.question: How many bills were issued from 15 March 2023 to 15 April 2023, including both days?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM billing WHERE bill_date BETWEEN '2023-03-15' AND '2023-04-15'

questions.question: Show the number of appointments in each month of 2023, in calendar order.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(appointment_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND appointment_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(appointment_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

questions.question: Which patients registered last year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT patient_id, first_name, last_name FROM patients WHERE registration_date >= '2023-01-01' AND registration_date < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: What is the total billed amount for each doctor specialization?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d.specialization, SUM(b.amount) FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id GROUP BY d.specialization

questions.question: For patients insured by MedCare Plus, how many treatments of each treatment type did they receive?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT t.treatment_type, COUNT(*) FROM treatments AS t JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN patients AS p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.insurance_provider = 'MedCare Plus' GROUP BY t.treatment_type

questions.question: What is the total amount of failed bills in each hospital branch?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d.hospital_branch, SUM(b.amount) FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE b.payment_status = 'Failed' GROUP BY d.hospital_branch

questions.question: How many appointments has each patient had? Include patients who have none.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.patient_id, COUNT(a.appointment_id) FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN appointments AS a ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id GROUP BY p.patient_id

questions.question: How many emergency appointments does each doctor have, including doctors with none?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d.doctor_id, COUNT(a.appointment_id) FROM doctors AS d LEFT JOIN appointments AS a ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id AND a.reason_for_visit = 'Emergency' GROUP BY d.doctor_id

questions.question: Which insurance providers cover more than 16 patients?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT insurance_provider FROM patients GROUP BY insurance_provider HAVING COUNT(*) > 16

questions.question: How many different patients have at least one bill?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM billing

questions.question: What is the average treatment cost for each treatment type, rounded to 2 decimals?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT treatment_type, ROUND(AVG(cost), 2) FROM treatments GROUP BY treatment_type

questions.question: Show the number of appointments per status as a donut chart
questions.reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM appointments GROUP BY status

questions.question: Pie chart of the number of bills by payment method please
questions.reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) FROM billing GROUP BY payment_method

questions.question: How many appointments did Dr. Robert have in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id = 'D007' AND appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND appointment_date < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: How many cancelled appointments did each specialization have in the first half of 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d.specialization, COUNT(*) FROM appointments AS a JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE a.status = 'Cancelled' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-07-01' GROUP BY d.specialization

questions.question: List the bills issued in October 2023 for Completed appointments, with each bill's amount.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT b.bill_id, b.amount FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id WHERE a.status = 'Completed' AND b.bill_date >= '2023-10-01' AND b.bill_date < '2023-11-01'

questions.question: How many patients registered in 2022 had at least one appointment in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) FROM patients AS p JOIN appointments AS a ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE p.registration_date >= '2022-01-01' AND p.registration_date < '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: Show every consultation of Dr. Linda Brown in Q3 2023 with the invoice amounts.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, b.amount FROM appointments AS a LEFT JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id LEFT JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.doctor_id = 'D008' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-07-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-10-01'

questions.question: What is the total paid amount per insurance provider of the billed patients?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.insurance_provider, SUM(b.amount) FROM billing AS b JOIN patients AS p ON b.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE b.payment_status = 'Paid' GROUP BY p.insurance_provider

questions.question: How many distinct patients had appointments with Dr. Sarah Taylor in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM appointments WHERE doctor_id = 'D005' AND appointment_date >= '2023-01-01' AND appointment_date < '2024-01-01'

questions.question: all appointments with Dr. David Taylor for this month, including the patient's name, the invoice amount, and the hospital branch.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, b.amount FROM appointments AS a LEFT JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id LEFT JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.doctor_id = 'D001' AND a.appointment_date >= '2023-11-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-12-01'

questions.question: List only the appointments in November 2023 that have an invoice, with the invoice amount.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, b.amount FROM appointments AS a JOIN treatments AS t ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN billing AS b ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id WHERE a.appointment_date >= '2023-11-01' AND a.appointment_date < '2023-12-01'

questions.question: How much was billed in total for Completed appointments at each branch?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT d.hospital_branch, SUM(b.amount) FROM billing AS b JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE a.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY d.hospital_branch
